# Lanes

> Lanes is a read-only, all-monospace Git dashboard for macOS. The whole repository (branches, commits, working tree, stashes) is on screen in under 400 ms from a cold start, even on an 85,000-commit repository like git/git. Open source under the MIT license, signed with a Developer ID and notarized by Apple.

## What it is
- A native macOS app (Swift, SwiftPM, no Electron) that shows a Git repository at a glance.
- Read-only by design: it never runs a command that changes your repository. Use it next to your terminal or editor.
- Requirements: Apple Silicon, macOS 15 or later, the `git` binary from Xcode or the Command Line Tools.

- Cold start budget: under 400 ms to a full dashboard.
- Tested on git/git (about 85,000 commits).
- License: MIT. Price: free.
